scope: non-desktop public SEP/presentation; no OS cache purge, no real model speed claim

dataset.attachments: Run subset: text/image/file/image; 29-byte UTF-8 file and distinct 2x2 PNGs from existing mixed fixture
dataset.family: only actual public producer: one parent/one child with two history pages; absent capability requires fixed contract evidence

iterations.coldDefinition: new owned AgentKit/harness process, existing immutable runtime and same dataset; OS file cache uncontrolled and recorded
iterations.warmDefinition: same process after one excluded initialization iteration
iterations.percentile: nearest-rank; retain all samples including failures

measurement.memory: per-process OS resident-size samples every 50ms; report sampled peak (not exact allocator peak), include sampling limits
measurement.machine: record hardware/OS/power/thermal before run; same machine and power mode baseline/candidate
measurement.latencyStartEnd: original intent/request accepted timestamp to matching source publication; reconnect explicit intent to same-session inventory/history convergence
measurement.provider: loopback deterministic fixture with explicit holds excluded from latency interval; raw events retained
measurement.comparison: baseline/candidate same supported dataset; new capability without baseline must meet absolute budget and be marked no-comparable-baseline, not a regression pass
measurement.failurePolicy: missing sample/failed protocol/capability mismatch is failed or not_run with reason; no replacing or dropping failed iterations

notRunReasons: Candidate functional #55/#56 still partial; Native busy queue Kernel #86 failure remains blocking
